description_en: Queries information about a created Fileset
kebab_example: aliyun nas get-fileset --file-system-id cpfs-099394bd928c0000 --fset-id fset-1902718ea0ae0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetFileset

parameters.help_en:
The file system ID.

CPFS: The ID must start with `cpfs-`, such as cpfs-125487\\.

CPFS for Lingjun: The ID must start with `bmcpfs-`, such as bmcpfs-0015\\
parameters.help_zh:
文件系统ID。

CPFS：必须以`cpfs-`开头，例如cpfs-125487\\。

CPFS智算版：必须以`bmcpfs-`开头，例如bmcpfs-0015\\
parameters.name: file_system_id

parameters.help_en:
The Fileset ID.
This parameter is required if the file system type is CPFS
parameters.help_zh:
Fileset ID。
当文件系统类型为CPFS时，该参数必填
parameters.name: fset_id

CreateTime.description_en:
The time when the Fileset was created.

Format: `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`
CreateTime.description_zh:
Fileset的创建时间。

返回格式：`yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`

DeletionProtection.description_en:
The release protection property of the instance. Specifies whether the instance can be released from the console or by calling the [DeleteFileset]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2402263.html） operation.

true: Release protection is enabled.
false (default): Release protection is disabled.

This property applies only to manual release operations and does not apply to system-initiated release operations
DeletionProtection.description_zh:
实例释放保护属性，指定是否支持通过控制台或API（[DeleteFileset]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2402263.html））释放实例。

true：开启实例释放保护。
false（默认）：关闭实例释放保护。

该属性只能限制手动释放操作，对系统释放操作不生效

FileCountUsage.description_en:
The file count usage.
Only CPFS for Lingjun 2.7.0 and later support this parameter
FileCountUsage.description_zh:
文件数量使用量。
仅CPFS智算版2.7.0及以上版本支持此参数

FileSystemId.description_en:
The file system ID.

CPFS: The ID must start with `cpfs-`, such as cpfs-125487\\.

CPFS for Lingjun: The ID must start with `bmcpfs-`, such as bmcpfs-0015\\
FileSystemId.description_zh:
文件系统ID。

CPFS：必须以`cpfs-`开头，例如cpfs-125487\\。

CPFS智算版：必须以`bmcpfs-`开头，例如bmcpfs-0015\\

FileSystemPath.description_en: The path of the Fileset in the CPFS file system

FsetId.description_en:
The Fileset ID.
This parameter is required if the file system type is CPFS
FsetId.description_zh:
Fileset ID。
当文件系统类型为CPFS时，该参数必填

Quota.description_en:
The quota information.
Only CPFS for Lingjun 2.7.0 and later support this parameter
Quota.description_zh:
配额信息。
仅CPFS智算版2.7.0及以上版本支持此参数

FileCountLimit.description_en:
The file count limit of the quota. Value range:

Minimum value: 10,000.

Maximum value: 10,000,000,000
FileCountLimit.description_zh:
配额文件数量限制。取值范围：

最小值：10,000。

最大值：10,000,000,000

SizeLimit.description_en:
The total capacity limit of the quota. Unit: bytes.

Value range:

Minimum value: 10,737,418,240 (10 GiB).

Increment: 1,073,741,824 (1 GiB)
SizeLimit.description_zh:
配额总容量限制。单位：Byte。

取值范围：

最小值：10,737,418,240（10 GiB）。

步长：1,073,741,824（1 GiB）

SpaceUsage.description_en:
The capacity usage. Unit: bytes.
Only CPFS for Lingjun 2.7.0 and later support this parameter
SpaceUsage.description_zh:
容量使用量。单位：Byte。
仅CPFS智算版2.7.0及以上版本支持此参数

Status.description_en:
The status of the Fileset. Valid values:

CREATING: The Fileset is being created.
CREATED: The Fileset is created and running as expected. 
RELEASING: The Fileset is being released.
RELEASED: The Fileset is deleted
Status.description_zh:
Fileset的状态。包括：

CREATING：正在创建Fileset。
CREATED：Fileset已创建完成，正常运行中。 
RELEASING：Fileset正在释放中。
RELEASED：Fileset已删除

UpdateTime.description_en:
The time when the Fileset was last updated.

Format: `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`
UpdateTime.description_zh:
Fileset的最近一次更新时间。

返回格式：`yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`
